description: Status of a running PS2 game started with pcsx2_upscale_multiplier 8x, from a host with gamePerformance, recorded with the real LRPS2 at LRPS2_COMMIT and Jak and Daxter, 90 seconds after start, on an NVIDIA RTX 4080 SUPER (WGL, OpenGL 3.3 core). The PC could not keep up at 8x: speed 0.6273, so the game itself ran at 63% of its speed over the last 5 seconds, and the median retro_run took 1.58 frames' time. options shows one of the 69 options LRPS2 listed; the rest are as LRPS2 gives them. Copied from anyps5-retro-host fixtures/v1/messages/call-status-ps2-performance.json at 358c9fa.
